purpose: Prove the open Agent-neutral demand-driven human-Agent collaboration quality harness through goal-level natural-task dogfooding, dynamic capability discovery and lifecycle arbitration, an accepted methodology and open quality-conformance profile, and thin cross-host reference adapters that reuse sufficient external protocol, runtime, identity, audit, provenance, and evaluation layers.

increments.observedProblem: O4 requires the same pre-registered methodology, quality profile, scorecard, and missing-data rules across the first three eligible accepted tasks and a stopped case, but the current tree exposes only distributed acceptance clauses and no directly applicable versioned candidate; starting another natural measurement now would risk post-hoc packaging or make the receipt ineligible for the O4 cohort.
increments.hypothesis: One lean, explicitly unaccepted candidate that applies the existing authority without duplicating it can freeze the demand-to-capability method, mandatory floors, missing-data rule, nine observed user-loss classes, and Codex-first claim ceiling before the first eligible cohort receipt, while adding no runtime, wire, generic receipt schema, or user learning burden.
increments.falsifier: The candidate becomes a fourth product authority, changes O1-O5, requires the user to learn tools or Harness vocabulary, invents a runtime, wire, audit or receipt ecosystem, hides a mandatory failure behind scoring, cannot map every current O4 axis and the nine observed loss classes, or claims accepted methodology, behavior, portability, release, or production evidence.
increments.stopCondition: Stop when one versioned unaccepted candidate methodology and minimum quality-conformance profile is a protected public supporting document, future task registration can bind its exact Git and content identity before measured execution, all mandatory floors and missing-data behavior are directly applicable without a parallel acceptance system, public and machine status remain aligned, O1-O5 remain false, verification and tests pass, residue is absent, and the slice is committed and pushed before leaving the current graph.

deliverables: one versioned unaccepted demand-to-capability methodology and minimum quality-conformance candidate for exact pre-registration by future Codex cohort tasks
